subject: Draft engagement chronology & owners — please confirm stakeholders and critical path
messages:
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>
To: Julia Park <julia.park@novamed.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 06 Dec 2026 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: Draft engagement chronology & owners — please confirm stakeholders and critical path

Hi Julia — great conversation this morning. Thanks for the context on Novamed's 2027 roadmap and the compliance gate ahead of procurement. Per our discovery, attached is an initial Mutual Action Plan (MAP) that captures the milestones we discussed, two timeline options (conservative and accelerated), and an early assignment of owners.

Quick summary of what's in the attachment (Novamed_MAP_v1.xlsx):
- Milestone A: Integration scoping + test dataset handoff (Owner: Novamed POC)
- Milestone B: Security questionnaire & SOC evidence review (Owner: Redwood Security)
- Milestone C: Pilot deployment (Owner: Redwood Solutions)
- Milestone D: Commercial review + procurement sign-off (Owner: Novamed Procurement)

Two timeline options are included:
1) Accelerated: 6–8 weeks to pilot, target commercial close in 8–10 weeks (needs prioritized security docs and a committed Novamed technical lead)
2) Conservative: 10–14 weeks to pilot, target close in 12–16 weeks (buffers for procurement and internal compliance reviews)

Ask: can you confirm who at Novamed will own Milestone A and Milestone D, and whether the accelerated timeline is realistic for your team? Also please confirm any additional stakeholders we should add to the MAP (e.g., legal contact, security reviewer, platform engineer).

Next actions I propose:
- You confirm stakeholders and preferred timeline by EOD Wednesday (Dec 8).
- We update the MAP and circulate a final kickoff invite for the pilot planning session.

I've CC'd Marcus (solutions) and Monica (CS) to ensure we capture technical and adoption milestones correctly.

Attachments: Novamed_MAP_v1.xlsx; redwood-map-playbook.pdf

Thanks —
Stephanie Nguyen
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com
(415) 555-0198

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>, Julia Park <julia.park@novamed.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 06 Dec 2026 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Draft engagement chronology & owners — please confirm stakeholders and critical path

Stephanie / Julia — quick technical note after reading the draft MAP.

Thanks for pulling this together, Stephanie. I recommend we reorder two milestones for the accelerated track: perform the security evidence review (Milestone B) in parallel with integration scoping (Milestone A) so the pilot can start earlier. To make that parallelization work we need:
- Novamed to provide a minimal dataset and environment access for baseline tests within 7 business days of confirming owners.
- Novamed security reviewer (name/email) to accept an evidence request packet — I'll prepare the packet and drop it in the Drive link.

Also suggesting we add an explicit 'rollback & data retention' checkpoint between pilot and commercial review to capture compliance acceptance criteria. I've noted that as a line item in the attached redwood-map-playbook.pdf.

Happy to join the kickoff once stakeholders are listed.

Marcus Lin
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.com

From: Julia Park <julia.park@novamed.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>
Cc: Novamed Procurement <procurement@novamed.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 07 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: Draft engagement chronology & owners — please confirm stakeholders and critical path

Stephanie — appreciate the tidy summary. Quick answers:

- Stakeholders: I'll be the program lead (Julia Park). For Milestone A (integration scoping) please assign to Carlos Mendes (platform lead) — carlos.mendes@novamed.com. For Milestone D (procurement) I'll loop in procurement@novamed.com (cc'd). Legal will be added if we move past pilot.
- Timeline: The accelerated timeline is ambitious but feasible if we hit the following:
  * Carlos can carve out 4 hours/week for discovery tasks starting next week
  * We get the Redwood evidence packet and initial SOC excerpts this week (Marcus noted he'll prepare the packet)
  * Procurement has provisional slot on Dec 20 for a commercial review (they asked for documentation a week prior)

Notes: Procurement prefers the conservative close window unless we confirm parallel security review — so target close is likely between Jan 12–26 unless we accelerate security sign-off.

I'll confirm Carlos' availability by EOD Wednesday (Dec 8). If Carlos is good, we're aligned with Marcus' suggestion to run the security evidence collection in parallel.

Thanks —
Julia Park
Program Lead, AI Integrations | Novamed
julia.park@novamed.com

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>
To: Julia Park <julia.park@novamed.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Novamed Procurement <procurement@novamed.com>
Date: Tue, 08 Dec 2026 11:32:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Draft engagement chronology & owners — please confirm stakeholders and critical path

Perfect — thanks for the quick turnaround, Julia. Noted: Carlos Mendes for Milestone A and procurement@novamed.com for Milestone D.

Actions I'm taking now:
- I'll update Novamed_MAP_v1.xlsx with Carlos as Milestone A owner and add the rollback/data-retention checkpoint Marcus suggested.
- Marcus will share the evidence packet to the Drive link by EOD today.
- Monica will schedule the pilot planning kickoff once Carlos confirms availability (Monica: can you propose two slots next week?).

Tentative next dates:
- Carlos availability confirmation: EOD Dec 8 (Julia)
- Evidence packet delivered: Dec 8 (Marcus)
- Pilot planning kickoff (proposed): Dec 9 or Dec 10

If procurement prefers the conservative close window but we complete parallel security work, we should still be able to target Jan 12–19 for commercial review acceptance. I'll mark the MAP with a "target close range" of Jan 12–26 and a secondary accelerated target of Jan 5–12.

Thanks again — I'll circulate the updated MAP and calendar invite once I have Carlos' confirmation and Marcus' packet.

Stephanie Nguyen
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com
(415) 555-0198
